decisions.reason: As a home-page product in its launch year and closely tied to the firm's apparent messaging infrastructure, it likely builds strongly on existing knowledge and merits continued refinement rather than withdrawal.

Its own page suggests meaningful commitment, and while document capture and recognition is somewhat broader than core message transport, the firm should still be able to learn and improve it using adjacent document-processing capabilities.

Email and fax conversion appears highly related to the firm's existing communication-services base, so even with limited website prominence the firm is likely to retain it as a coherent extension of what it already knows.
A fax delivery optimization feature is a close incremental improvement to an established fax service domain, making it low risk to absorb, interpret, and enhance commercially.

Email sandbox threat protection is strategically relevant but more knowledge-intensive and competitive, so it carries a higher pruning risk despite being related enough to justify another year of learning.

Multi-engine email virus scanning fits the firm's email-services knowledge base, and although only modestly highlighted on the site, it is still close enough to core capabilities to keep while gathering more market feedback.
